objective: Preallocate query aggregate fast-path data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate query aggregate data prefixes
tasks.result: Query aggregate COUNT and primary-key MIN/MAX fast paths now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in the query aggregate COUNT prefix-count path and primary-key MIN/MAX key-bound path.
Generated prefix bytes, count_prefix inputs, first/last key bounds, primary-key extraction, and SQL result rows are unchanged.
